---
title: "Troubleshooting"
---

## Start with the returned status

Record the method ID, returned status, error, provider, timestamp and the exact form used.

## Form does not open MethodMesh

Check:

- MethodMesh is installed;
- the example uses the current execution action;
- the method ID exists in the installed build;
- the `body::intent` value is on the intended group;
- the form was re-uploaded and re-downloaded after editing.

## MethodMesh opens but nothing returns

Check:

- the output field names match the documented return names;
- the group is still active in ODK Collect;
- the user did not navigate away through Android recents;
- the operation was not cancelled;
- the provider returned an actual result rather than only closing;
- the call requested the appropriate return mode.

## Provider or hardware missing

Some capabilities depend on:

- Bluetooth hardware;
- an ESP32 sensor node;
- a Bluetooth printer;
- an installed provider application;
- a downloaded ML Kit model;
- Android biometric or device-credential configuration;
- an NFC-capable phone.

The capability page lists its specific requirements.

## Permission denied

Grant only the permission needed by the method, then repeat the whole call from the form.

Common permissions include camera, microphone, Bluetooth/nearby devices, NFC, location, notifications and SMS.

## Works online but not offline

Look for:

- a model that has not been downloaded;
- a map package that is absent;
- an external provider using a remote service;
- an online URL target;
- files that exist only in cloud storage.

## Report a reproducible issue

Include:

- MethodMesh version;
- device and Android version;
- EDC application and version;
- capability and call;
- example workbook name;
- expected output;
- actual output;
- whether airplane mode was enabled.

Do not include participant identifiers, credentials, cryptographic private keys or sensitive payloads.
